description.value: Pizza Garden is a BC-based Neapolitan pizza chain operated by Neapolitan Pizza Ltd., with over 25 years in the industry and locations stretching from Victoria to Fort St. John. The Downtown Vancouver location serves wood-fired pizzas with authentic charred crusts, sun-ripened tomatoes, and creamy mozzarella, with both indoor and outdoor seating available. Cyclists will find it a convenient, filling stop in the heart of Vancouver's downtown core, with takeout and delivery also on offer.
